headline: Glass Lewis Endorses Bergeron in Ethan Allen Proxy Contest
summary: Proxy advisory firm Glass Lewis has backed investor Bergeron in an ongoing proxy battle against Ethan Allen Interiors.
why: Ethan Allen is a prominent American furniture designer and retailer; recommendations from proxy advisory firms often sway institutional shareholder voting.

impacts.name: Ethan Allen Interiors Inc.
impacts.why: Support from a major proxy advisor increases the chances of activist representation on the company's board.
